items.title: FINMA approves Switzerland’s first Bitcoin ETF for retail investors
items.summary: The Swiss regulator cited a growing appetite for cryptocurrency investments and said that multiple fund providers have submitted Bitcoin ETF applications.

items.title: Equity weakness could damp demand for bitcoin after biggest ETF inflows in a month
Bitcoin drops to $81,400 as Asian chip stocks tumble, options traders seek downside protection
items.summary: Bitcoin slipped 0.5% to around $81,400 even after the biggest daily spot ETF inflow in nearly a month as South Korea's Kospi index fell 3.7% on AI worries.

items.title: Bitcoin ETFs just saw their biggest day in a month thanks entirely to BlackRock
items.summary: Fidelity's FBTC and Grayscale's GBTC saw outflows of $83.6 million and $54.9 million, respectively.
